description: Extend the new filter experience to support filtering by specific values for simple data types (like strings, numbers, booleans). This should integrate with the existing filter UI components and provide users with intuitive controls to select or input filter values.
functional_requirements: Add value-based filter options to the new filter popover UI for simple data types
Ensure the filter logic correctly handles equality comparisons for different simple types
Integrate the value filtering capability with the existing row context menu for consistency
Maintain backward compatibility with existing filter functionality during the transition
